smallTalk.response: Hey! I'm the BrandPulse assistant. Ask me anything about our services, pricing, process, or results — I'll give you a straight answer.

I can answer questions across our 6 core capabilities (AI Solutions, Digital Marketing, Product Building, ERP, CRM, Strategic Consulting), our 4-stage process, pricing structure, 14-day prototype guarantee, and client results.
Happy to help! Anything else you want to know about BrandPulse?

faqs.question: What services does BrandPulse offer?
faqs.answer: BrandPulse provides six unified capabilities under one roof: AI Solutions (custom agents, RAG, automation), Digital Marketing (full-funnel systems, organic & paid growth), Product Building (web & mobile apps, design systems), ERP Systems (integrated inventory, HR, accounting), CRM Systems (pipeline telemetry & automated outreach), and Strategic Consulting (due diligence, architecture audits, fractional CTO advisory).

faqs.question: What is AI Solutions and what does it include?
faqs.answer: Our AI Solutions include custom AI integrations, LLM pipelines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, autonomous AI agents and workflow automation, and domain-specific AI model fine-tuning. We design systems that run 24/7 without manual intervention to qualify leads, extract insights, and reduce repetitive operations.

faqs.question: What is Digital Marketing at BrandPulse?
faqs.answer: Digital Marketing at BrandPulse is about building repeatable revenue engines, not vanity metrics. We deploy full-funnel customer acquisition systems combining data-driven paid advertising (ROAS optimization), technical SEO and topical authority clusters, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and omni-channel automated lifecycle marketing.

faqs.question: What is Product Building?
faqs.answer: Product Building covers end-to-end design, development, and deployment of web applications, platforms, and digital products from scratch. We build type-safe, sub-second latency interfaces paired with scalable cloud backends, backed by our 14-day working prototype guarantee.

faqs.question: What are ERP Systems and who are they for?
faqs.answer: Our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems connect inventory, accounting, procurement, HR, and supply chain into a single centralized operational nervous system. They are designed for growing manufacturing, distribution, retail, and service businesses needing unified visibility and real-time ledger synchronization.

faqs.question: What are CRM Systems and who are they for?
faqs.answer: Our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) solutions unify pipeline stages, automated client follow-ups, omnichannel communication (WhatsApp, Email, SMS), and rep activity telemetry so sales teams never lose track of deals or revenue opportunities.

faqs.question: What is Strategic Consulting?
faqs.answer: Strategic Consulting includes technical due diligence, architecture feasibility audits, toolchain cost rationalization, and fractional CTO advisory. We help leadership teams de-risk high-stakes technology decisions, eliminate wasteful spend, and prepare for institutional investor diligence.

faqs.question: Do you do mobile apps?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build high-performance iOS and Android applications using modern cross-platform frameworks (React Native) or native toolchains, complete with offline data sync, sub-second startup times, and enterprise-grade security.

faqs.question: Do you do e-commerce?
faqs.answer: Yes. We architect headless and custom e-commerce engines with sub-second page transitions, personalized recommendation algorithms, real-time inventory management, and automated checkout flows built to maximize average order value and conversion rate.

faqs.question: Can you help a non-technical founder?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. A large portion of our clients are commercial and domain-expert founders. We translate business objectives into rock-solid technical architectures, eliminate vendor lock-in, and guide you through every milestone in plain business language.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing varies based on scope and engagement type. Initial discovery calls are 100% free. Fractional CTO advisory is delivered on a weekly retainer. Architecture feasibility audits and prototype sprints are fixed project-based pricing with transparent milestone guarantees. Book a free 20-minute call for an exact scope breakdown.

faqs.question: What is the 14-day prototype guarantee?
faqs.answer: BrandPulse guarantees a fully functional, interactive working prototype running on realistic test data within 14 days of project kickoff. If we do not deliver a working prototype by day 14, the first iteration is completely free. This applies to all product-building engagements.

faqs.question: What does the Return Guarantee mean?
faqs.answer: BrandPulse offers a return guarantee on advisory engagements: if you do not see measurable operational or financial improvement within the agreed timeframe, we continue working at no charge until you achieve the agreed milestone.

faqs.question: What is the average capital saved from your audit?
faqs.answer: BrandPulse clients save an average of $180,000+ by avoiding costly technical missteps, premature microservice rewrites, overprovisioned cloud infrastructure, and bloated agency retainers.

faqs.question: How many audits have you delivered?
faqs.answer: We have executed 45+ high-conviction technical evaluations and architecture feasibility audits for venture-backed startups and growth enterprises.

faqs.question: What cloud savings have you achieved for clients?
faqs.answer: We have identified and eliminated over $1.4M in cloud, database, and API token waste across our client portfolios, typically slashing infrastructure bills by 40% to 60%.

faqs.question: How does your process work?
faqs.answer: Our process follows a rigorous 4-stage sprint: Week 1 (Deep Technical Discovery: leadership interviews, repo audits, contract reviews), Week 2 (Diagnostic Scorecard: objective report on architecture health, security gaps, hidden expenses), Week 3 (Remediation Roadmap: prioritized sprints to fix bottlenecks and raise velocity), followed by Monthly Strategic Partnership (bi-weekly advisory and on-demand architecture guidance).

faqs.question: How long does an audit take?
faqs.answer: A standard BrandPulse Architecture Feasibility Audit takes exactly 2 weeks from initial kickoff to delivery of the executive diagnostic scorecard and remediation roadmap.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Getting started begins with a free, confidential 20-minute discovery call. We review your current systems, identify critical bottlenecks, and outline exact milestones and ROI before any contract is signed.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups?
faqs.answer: Yes. We frequently partner with pre-seed to Series B startups to establish their core architecture, build 14-day production prototypes, and ensure their systems pass technical due diligence from institutional venture investors.

faqs.question: Do you work with enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. We consult with enterprise and mid-market organizations to modernize legacy monolithic infrastructure, audit cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and integrate enterprise ERP/CRM systems with zero downtime.

faqs.question: Can I hire you for just one week?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer focused 1-week Deep Discovery Sprints or targeted architectural reviews for teams facing an urgent bottleneck, failed vendor handover, or impending board review.

faqs.question: What does the Architecture Feasibility Audit include?
faqs.answer: The Architecture Feasibility Audit includes a comprehensive evaluation of existing codebase structure, database query latency profiling, security & vulnerability assessments, and cloud bill & API token optimization with prioritized remediation steps.

faqs.question: What is the Zero-Trust Enterprise Vulnerability Review?
faqs.answer: It is an exhaustive security audit covering role-based access control (RBAC), data encryption in transit and at rest, third-party library dependencies, API endpoints, and credential leak risks to ensure enterprise-grade security posture.

faqs.question: What is the Model & Toolchain Cost Optimizer?
faqs.answer: A dedicated diagnostic service that identifies redundant software tool spend, inefficient LLM token usage, and overprovisioned cloud servers — delivering an average 60% reduction in cloud and API waste.

faqs.question: What is the Executive Due Diligence Deck?
faqs.answer: A board- and investor-ready technical audit document specifically designed to help companies pass rigorous technical due diligence from institutional venture capital and private equity investors.

faqs.question: What is Fractional CTO Advisory?
faqs.answer: Fractional CTO Advisory is a weekly retainer engagement where senior BrandPulse partners act as your part-time CTO — providing executive technical leadership, vendor management, senior hiring reviews, and architecture decisions without the cost of a full-time executive hire.

faqs.question: What is Product Roadmap & Moat Formulation?
faqs.answer: A strategic advisory engagement where we evaluate your competitive landscape, determine proprietary technical moats (data flywheels, custom algorithms, defensible APIs), and create a phased product roadmap aligned with revenue expansion.

faqs.question: Show me a case study.
faqs.answer: For a Growth-Stage B2B Platform: Their engineering team was trapped in a 9-month rewrite with mounting cloud bills and zero feature delivery. BrandPulse conducted an architecture audit, halted unnecessary microservice fragmentation, and established clear milestone velocity. Result: Cloud spend dropped 54%, and the core product shipped to production in 6 weeks.

faqs.question: What results do your clients get?
faqs.answer: On average, BrandPulse clients achieve 3x faster engineering decision cycles, $180,000+ in saved capital, 50%+ reduction in unnecessary cloud expenses, and a 100% technical diligence clearance rate with institutional investors.

faqs.question: What is your investor diligence clearance rate?
faqs.answer: 100% of BrandPulse clients undergoing institutional venture capital or private equity technical diligence have successfully passed evaluation.

faqs.question: Who said BrandPulse brought the exact balance of technical rigor and commercial reality?
faqs.answer: That was stated by the Founder & CEO of CoreSync, a verified enterprise client who partnered with BrandPulse to rebuild their operational telemetry and architecture.

faqs.question: Where is BrandPulse based?
faqs.answer: BrandPulse is based in Pune, India, and works with clients and venture-backed organizations globally across the United States, Europe, APAC, and India.

faqs.question: How do I contact BrandPulse?
faqs.answer: You can reach us directly via email at hello@brandpulse.in or book a free 20-minute discovery call directly on the website.

faqs.question: How do I book a call?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a call by clicking any '[ BOOK A CALL ]' button on the website, or by scrolling to the contact section at the bottom. Discovery calls are 20 minutes and completely free.

faqs.question: Is BrandPulse a full-service agency?
faqs.answer: Yes. We combine artificial intelligence engineering, product development, digital marketing systems, enterprise ERP/CRM implementation, and strategic consulting under one disciplined roof.

faqs.question: What makes BrandPulse different from other agencies?
faqs.answer: We combine senior engineering discipline with commercial executive strategy. We don't just build features — we audit, de-risk, and optimize the bottom line. Furthermore, our Return Guarantee and 14-Day Working Prototype Guarantee mean we are directly accountable for concrete business results.
